events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began in Bethel, New York, a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Summer of Love vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and legendary music. What would be on your festival playlist?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll. Elvis Presley's music and legacy live on. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon. His guitar work redefined music. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and rock 'n' roll attitude continue to inspire. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's rock 'n' roll spirit
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that iconic swagger to the music scene. What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you plugged in an iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy film franchise.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which Bond film or song is your ultimate favourite? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring impact
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Monty Python laughs
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album deep cuts
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What are your hidden gems from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's legendary voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song to blast out loud?
